function getLastChildGoingHome(array $inputs, int $candies): int
{
    foreach ($inputs as &$value) {
        $value = $value % $candies === 0 ? $value / $candies : (int)($value / $candies) + 1;
    }

    $last = 0;
    $lastIdx = 0;

    foreach ($inputs as $i => $value) {
        if ($value >= $last) {
            $last = $value;
            $lastIdx = $i;
        }
    }

    return $lastIdx + 1;
}

$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$parts = explode(' ', $line);
$n1 = (int)$parts[0];
$n2 = (int)$parts[1];

$n = (int)trim(fgets(STDIN));

$idx = ($n - 1) % 6;
$neg = false;
$current = $n1;

if ($idx >= 3) {
    $neg = true;
    $idx -= 3;
}

if ($idx === 1) {
    $current = $n2;
} elseif ($idx === 2) {
    $current = $n2 - $n1;
}

if ($neg) {
    $current *= -1;
}

$mod = 1000000007;
$result = (($current % $mod) + $mod) % $mod;
echo $result . PHP_EOL;

            $current = $current * -1;
        }

        $mod = 1000000007;
        $result = (($current % $mod) + $mod) % $mod;
        echo $result . "\n";
    }

    public static function GetLastChildGoingHome(array $inputs, int $candies): int
    {
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($inputs); $i++) {
            if ($inputs[$i] % $candies == 0) {
                $inputs[$i] = $inputs[$i] / $candies;
            } else {
                $inputs[$i] = (int)($inputs[$i] / $candies) + 1;
            }
        }

        $last = 0;
        $lastIdx = 0;

        for ($i = 0; $i < count($inputs); $i++) {
            if ($inputs[$i] >= $last) {
                $last = $inputs[$i];
                $lastIdx = $i;
            }
        }

        return $lastIdx + 1;
    }
}

class Input
{
    private static $buffer = '';
    private static $tokens = [];

    private static function readLine(): ?string
    {
        return fgets(STDIN);
    }

    private static function ensureTokens(): void
    {
        if (empty(self::$tokens)) {
            $line = self::readLine();
            if ($line === false || $line === '') {
                return;
            }
            self::$tokens = array_map('trim', explode(' ', trim($line)));
            self::$tokens = array_filter(self::$tokens, function($v) { return $v !== ''; });
            self::$tokens = array_values(self::$tokens);
        }
    }

    public static function NextInt(): int
    {
        self::ensureTokens();
        return (int)array_shift(self::$tokens);
    }

    public static function NextLong(): int
    {
        self::ensureTokens();
        return (int)array_shift(self::$tokens);
    }

    public static function NextLongs(int $count): array
    {
        $res = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $res[] = self::NextLong();
        }
        return $res;
    }

    public static function NextString(): string
    {
        self::ensureTokens();
        return (string)array_shift(self::$tokens);
    }
}
